Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Filter by target CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Keep only rows where canonical_smiles is present and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all activity rows.
